name: SSH Manager
description: A local-first SSH host manager for PI-Desktop with bounded OpenSSH commands that the AI can call through explicit, high-risk tools.

en.name: SSH Manager
en.description: A local-first SSH host manager with bounded OpenSSH commands that the AI can call through explicit, high-risk tools.
en.safetyNotes: Uses the system OpenSSH client and the user's existing config, ssh-agent, identity-file path, or a password entered in the panel. Passwords are held in memory for at most 30 minutes and never persisted or passed to AI. The plugin never stores private-key contents, command output, or remote transcripts. AI connect and execute tools are high risk and remote destructive patterns are blocked by default.

zh-CN.name: SSH 在线管理
zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 SSH 主机管理面板，使用 OpenSSH 执行有超时和输出上限的远程命令，并向 AI 暴露高风险工具。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 插件只调用系统 OpenSSH，并复用用户已有的 SSH 配置、ssh-agent、私钥路径或面板输入的密码；密码最多在内存中保留 30 分钟，不写入设置，也不会传给 AI。插件不保存私钥内容、命令输出或远程会话记录。AI 连接和执行工具均为高风险操作，常见破坏性命令默认拦截。

author: PI-Desktop
changelog: Release 0.1.0: adds local SSH host profiles, strict host-key verification, OpenSSH key/agent and transient password authentication, bounded remote command execution, a focused management panel, and an AI skill describing safe SSH workflows.
safetyNotes: SSH credentials are never persisted by this plugin. Passwords entered in the panel are held in memory for at most 30 minutes and private-key contents stay outside the plugin. Authentication is delegated to the local OpenSSH client. The panel stores only connection metadata in plugin settings; AI tools can connect to configured hosts and execute remote shell commands, so PI-Desktop's high-risk tool policy must remain enabled.

agentTools.name: ssh_list_hosts
agentTools.description: List configured SSH host metadata without returning credential paths or secrets.

agentTools.name: ssh_connect
agentTools.description: Connect to a configured SSH host using local OpenSSH key, agent, config, or transient panel-password authentication.

accept_new_host_key.description: Allow OpenSSH to add a new host key after explicit user approval.

agentTools.name: ssh_execute
agentTools.description: Execute one bounded remote shell command on a configured SSH host.

session_id.description: Logical session id returned by ssh_connect.

profile_id.description: Profile id for a one-off command.

allow_destructive.description: Only after explicit user approval for a blocked destructive command.

accept_new_host_key.description: Allow a new host key for this run after explicit user approval.

agentTools.name: ssh_disconnect
agentTools.description: Forget a logical SSH session; no remote process is left running by the plugin.

session_id.description: Logical session id returned by ssh_connect.
